messages:
anna: Quick sync: CS reported two customers where billing shows partner keys charged but exchange logs show downstream SA. this is creating dispute tickets.

raj: Can you drop an example req id? I'll grab traces and meter entries.

anna: req=01LQY7Z3. trace: token_exchange span completed at +35ms with subject=sa-foo-9, but meter attributed partner:key-x.

mika: sounds like the router attribution vs async exchange timing again. we discussed wait windows previously but customers want a visible reconciliation path in console, not just infra fixes.

console-team: For UX: propose an "Attribution Reconciliation" card in the key detail page. shows recent requests with columns: req_id, timestamp, attributed_entity, effective_identity (collapsed), reason (exchange|fallback|pending), exchange_latency_ms, reconciled? and a link to trace. Only visible to org admins.

billing: If we add reconciled flag we need reconciliation provenance: who marked it, timestamp, and an audit id so we can generate credit suggestions. also want a CSV export for finance.

sec-bot: Security reminder: any effective_identity must be RBAC-gated to owners/admins. audit entries required for every manual reconciliation step. redact other org ids for non-admins.

raj: Operationally, we should add a reconciliation API: POST /internal/reconcile-attribution {req_id, reason, operator} -> returns audit_id. console will call that when admin approves suggested correction.

mika: Good. Also can we auto-suggest candidates by re-running attribution logic against traces? e.g., backfill-run: `go run cmd/attribution_backfill -from=now-48h -key=partner:key-x -limit=500` to propose corrections. UI should surface suggestions with confidence score.

console-team: UI flow: 1) List suggested corrections (confidence, diff tokens, trace_link), 2) bulk select and "Mark for finance review" which calls reconcile API to create audit entries + exports a CSV, 3) small banner warns that these are suggestions and not automatic billing changes. Only org admins see the full traces.

billing: CSV needs columns: audit_id, req_id, original_attributed_entity, suggested_entity, tokens, user-visible_reason, trace_link, suggested_credit_amount. Also need an approval webhook from finance once credits are applied so we can mark reconciled=true.

anna: For safety, console default: suggestions collapsed, confidence threshold 80+, and a toggle to include low-confidence. feature flag `console.attribution.reconciliation=true` during rollout.

raj: Metrics to add: auth.attribution.suggestions_total, auth.attribution.reconciled_total, auth.attribution.reconcile_latency_ms. Alerts: spike in suggestions for a key -> page eng.

mika: We'll also emit audit events: audit.attribution_suggested, audit.attribution_manual_override with operator id and audit_id. retention 90d.

sec-bot: Confirming retention policy: audit entries stored for 90d and accessible only to security+owners. need approval from legal for CSV export of identities beyond 30d.

console-team: UX detail: suggestions tile shows a small chip: green(>=90): suggest, amber(70-89): review, red(<70): manual only. clicking chip expands justification: signals used (trace timing, X-Effective-Principal presence, exchange-cache hit).

raj: Implementation plan: 1) infra: backfill runner + suggestion engine (mika) 2) router opt-in wait (raj) 3) reconcile API + audit schema (raj) 4) console: suggestions tile + CSV export behind flag (console-team) 5) billing: hook to accept CSV + webhook (billing) 6) sec/legal reviews (sec-bot).

anna: Timeline estimate: metrics + suggestion pilot for single partner key in 72h, reconcile API + audit in 1 week, console pilot (admin-only) in 2 weeks, backfill scale + CSV export after pilot.

billing: One more: for suggested credits, show a "potential dollars" estimate using current rate card and include a manual approval step. finance will not accept auto-credit without explicit approval.

mika: Dev note: suggestion engine should avoid touching billing state. produce an idempotent suggestion object stored in internal DB with `status: suggested|approved|applied|rejected`. only reconcile API transitions state.

console-team: We'll prototype a mockup and post link to PR. default UI collapsed and off for all orgs unless admin enables.

sec-bot: Reminder checklist: RBAC gate, audit entries, retention policy, legal sign-off for CSV. mark tasks in ticket.

anna: Thanks. I'll file the parent ticket and add sub-tasks for UI, infra, billing, and legal. tag customers in the CS note. if anyone wants to pair on the API spec ping me. :thumbsup:
